mapper.select: SELECT u.code, u.name FROM ( SELECT sys09_code AS code, sys09_name AS name, sys09_seq AS seq FROM sys09_code a INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind b ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys08_kind_cd LIKE #{kindCd} UNION SELECT '%', '전체보기', '0' ) u ORDER BY u.seq
mapper.sql: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN mkt05_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(mkt05_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(mkt05_org_id, f_today()) END FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = mkt01_target_company_id ORDER BY mkt05_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = mkt01_target_company_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.mkt01_target_company_id AS target_company_id , t.mkt01_item_type_cd AS item_type_code , t.mkt01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , t.mkt01_addr AS addr , t.mkt01_tel AS tel , t.mkt01_note AS note , COALESCE(t.mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') = 'true' AS unuse_yn , f_cdnm('CrmItemTypeCode', mkt01_item_type_cd, mkt01_company_id, f_today()) AS item_type_name , manager_info AS manager_info , () AS share_info FROM () t LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT mkt02_target_company_id , MIN(mkt02_manager_nm) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 ' || (COUNT(*) - 1) END as manager_info FROM mkt02_manager WHERE mkt02_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY mkt02_target_company_id ) mng ON mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id ORDER BY mkt01_target_company_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT mkt01_target_company_id AS target_company_id , mkt01_item_type_cd AS item_type_code , mkt01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , mkt01_addr AS addr , mkt01_tel AS tel , mkt01_note AS note , COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') = 'true' AS unuse_yn , f_cdnm('CrmItemTypeCode', mkt01_item_type_cd, mkt01_company_id, f_today()) AS item_type_name , ( SELECT MIN(mkt02_manager_nm) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| (COUNT(*) - 1) END FROM mkt02_manager WHERE mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id ) AS manager_info , () AS share_info FROM mkt01_target_company WHERE mkt01_target_company_id = #{targetCompanyId} AND mkt01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt01_target_company ( mkt01_target_company_id, mkt01_company_id, mkt01_item_type_cd, mkt01_target_company_nm , mkt01_addr, mkt01_tel, mkt01_note, mkt01_unuse_yn ) VALUES ( #{r.targetCompanyId}, #{companyId}, #{r.itemTypeCode}, #{r.targetCompanyName} , #{r.addr}, #{r.tel}, #{r.note}, CASE WHEN #{r.unuseYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END )
mapper.select: SELECT t.mkt01_favorite_id AS favorite_id , t.mkt01_target_company_id AS target_company_id , t.mkt01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , t.mkt01_manager_nm AS manager_name , t.mkt01_manager_pos_nm AS manager_pos_name , t.mkt01_manager_org_nm AS manager_org_name FROM (SELECT mkt01_target_company.* , mkt02_manager_nm AS mkt01_manager_nm , mkt02_pos_nm AS mkt01_manager_pos_nm , mkt02_org_nm AS mkt01_manager_org_nm , mkt06_favorite_id AS mkt01_favorite_id FROM mkt01_target_company LEFT OUTER JOIN mkt02_manager ON mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id INNER JOIN mkt06_favorite ON mkt06_manager_id = mkt02_manager_id WHERE mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt06_person_id = #{personId} AND COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') != 'true' AND UPPER(CONCAT(mkt01_target_company_nm, mkt02_manager_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})) t ORDER BY t.mkt01_target_company_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc , t.mkt01_manager_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT mkt01_target_company.* FROM mkt01_target_company LEFT OUTER JOIN mkt02_manager ON mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id INNER JOIN mkt06_favorite ON mkt06_manager_id = mkt02_manager_id WHERE mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt06_person_id = #{personId} AND COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') != 'true') t

SELECT mkt01_target_company_id FROM mkt01_target_company WHERE mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt01_item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCode} AND UPPER(REPLACE(mkt01_target_company_nm, ' ', '')) = UPPER(#{name}) ORDER BY mkt01_target_company_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt01_target_company ( mkt01_target_company_id, mkt01_company_id, mkt01_item_type_cd, mkt01_target_company_nm, mkt01_unuse_yn ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{companyId}, #{itemTypeCode}, #{name}, 'false' )

INSERT INTO mkt02_manager ( mkt02_manager_id, mkt02_target_company_id, mkt02_manager_nm, mkt02_org_nm, mkt02_pos_nm , mkt02_email_addr, mkt02_tel, mkt02_retire_info, mkt02_note, mkt02_company_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{targetCompanyId}, #{managerName}, #{orgName}, #{posName} , #{emailAddr}, #{tel}, #{retireInfo}, #{note}, #{companyId} )
INSERT INTO mkt06_favorite ( mkt06_favorite_id, mkt06_person_id, mkt06_manager_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{personId}, #{managerId} )

INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_string08 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , COALESCE(s.company_nm, ''), COALESCE(s.manager_nm, ''), COALESCE(s.org_nm, ''), COALESCE(s.pos_nm, '') , COALESCE(s.tel, ''), COALESCE(s.email_addr, ''), COALESCE(s.note, ''), COALESCE(s.retire_info, '') FROM ( SELECT mkt01_target_company_nm AS company_nm , mkt02_manager_nm AS manager_nm , mkt02_org_nm AS org_nm , mkt02_pos_nm AS pos_nm , mkt02_tel AS tel , mkt02_email_addr AS email_addr , mkt02_note AS note , mkt02_retire_info AS retire_info FROM mkt01_target_company LEFT OUTER JOIN mkt02_manager ON mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id WHERE mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt01_item_type_cd LIKE '%' AND COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') != 'true' AND UPPER(CONCAT(mkt01_target_company_nm, mkt02_manager_nm)) LIKE UPPER('%') ORDER BY mkt01_target_company_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc , mkt02_manager_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc ) s
